name: 75205 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75205 (Dallas) has 306 nonprofit organizations. 115 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 98 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75205 (Dallas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75205 (Dallas) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 66 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
